Dabbugottu Venkatamma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 13
October, 2023

Author: Ninala Jayasurya
Bench: Ninala Jayasurya
 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh :: Amaravati
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
 Writ Petition No.27088 of 2023
Between:-
Kamanchi Penchalaiah and 5 Others .... Petitioners
 And
The State of Andhra Pradesh,
Rep.by its Principal Secretary,
Irrigation Department and 4 Others ..... Respondents

entities.text: High Court Of Andhra Pradesh :: Amaravati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the Petitioners : Mr. M.S.R Chandra Murthy

Counsel for the Respondents : G.P. for Irrigation & Cad
 G.P. for Finance & Planning
 G.P. for Land Acquisition
ORDER:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition.
With their consent, the Writ Petition is disposed of at the stage of admission.

2. The Writ Petition is filed seeking to declare the inaction on the part of the respondents in paying the amount of compensation awarded in respect of the lands, which were acquired from petitioners through proceedings No.Rc.D3/93/2017 dated 26.02.2020 of an extent of Ac.18.16 cents situated at Pegallapadu Village, Marripadu Mandal, SPSR Nellore District., as illegal, arbitrary and violative of the rights guaranteed under Articles 19, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and for a consequential direction to the respondents to pay the compensation amount of Rs.22,00,772/- with the interest 15% P.A from date of proceedings 26.02.2020 till the date of payment as per the Sec.80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners with reference to the averments made in the Writ Petition submits that the petitioners are the absolute owners and possessors of lands in an extent of Ac.18.16 cents situated at Pegallapadu Village, Marripadu Mandal, SPSR Nellore District.
He submits that the said lands were acquired for the purpose of Balancing Reservoir IV under Anam Sanjeeva Reddy High Level Lift Canal under Telugu Ganga Project.

He submits that the proceedings dated 26.02.2020 was issued by the 4th respondent granting a compensation of Rs. 22,00,772/- towards Dabbugottu Venkatamma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40425388/
1 land and Rehabilitation and Resettlement.

entities.text: Dabbugottu Venkatamma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: But the compensation has not been paid to the petitioners.
He also submits that this Court in similar circumstances disposed of W.P.No.1758 of 2023 vide Order dated 30.01.2023 and that an Order on the same lines may be passed.
He further submits that non-payment of compensation is unjust, arbitrary and the delay in payment of compensation is causing serious prejudice and irreparable loss to the petitioners.
He submits that under those circumstances, the petitioners are constrained to approach this Court seeking appropriate directions.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition, on the other hand placed a copy of the written instructions dated 13.10.2023 received from the 5th respondent and on perusal of the same, it would appear that there is no dispute with regard to passing of Award referred to above and non-payment of compensation to the petitioners in respect of the subject matter lands.
However, it appears that due to insufficient funds, the payments have not been made to the petitioners.

The relevant portion of the instructions reads thus:-
"It is submitted that the ex-gratia proposals for tree values in Sy.Nos. 104/7 etc., to an extent of Ac. 18.16 for an amount of Rs.22,00,772/-(Rupees Twenty two lakhs seven hundred and seventy two only) was submitted to the Special Collector, Telugu Ganga Project, Nellore and the same was approved by the Special Collector, TGP,
Nellore vide Rc.D3.93/2017, Dt:26.02.2020.
It is further submitted that consequently the bill was uploaded for an amount of Rs.22,00,772/- (Rupees Twenty two lakhs seven hundred and seventy two only) in CFMS portal vide CFMS Bill No.952257/2021 on 12.07.2021 and it is cancelled due to technical issue and again a bill was uploaded in CFMS portal vide Bill No.2022-699547 on 26.07.2022 and it is migrated to CFMS Bill No.2023-231573 and it is still pending & it displays that "Bill waiting for Fund Clearance".
Hence in view of the above, it is submitted that after allotment of budget the award amount will be credited into the bank accounts of the petitioners."
5.
This Court has considered the submissions and perused the material on record.
There is no dispute with regard to taking over possession of the lands in question and passing of Award.
The petitioners are deprived of their lands way back in the year 2017 and it is unfortunate that the compensation has not been paid though the Award was passed in 2020.
Though the reasons are obvious as could be noticed from the written instructions, the same cannot be a ground to delay the payment of compensation to the petitioners.

6. However, considering the submissions made by the learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition that if some reasonable time is fixed, efforts would be made to make the payment to the petitioners, this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the Writ Petition with a direction to the respondents to pay the compensation amount to the petitioners, pursuant to the Award proceedings dated 26.02.2020, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of six (6)
weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.

Needless to state that this Order would not Dabbugottu Venkatamma vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 13 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40425388/
2 preclude the petitioners from claiming interest in respect of the awarded compensation before the appropriate Forum.
7.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Writ Petition is disposed of accordingly, with the above directions.
There shall be no order as to costs.

As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications in the above writ petition, if any,
shall stand closed.
